main_scope: S + C + D + D_out internal neural exp-bit faults in one global-random campaign

included.S0: can_bus groups from the v35/v38 S0 input-state family
included.S: S1-S5 Full-S registry targets from the v36/v38 full-leaf scan; legacy CLI argument still names this S1_only
included.D: runtime-hit LLM module targets from the D audit, with model.norm/lm_head logged as D boundary targets
included.D_out: model.norm and lm_head/logits boundary targets are explicitly present in v49_d_full_targets.txt

sampling_policy: global random over all eligible S/C/D/D_out targets; scope weights are proportional to eligible target counts and all within-scope target weights are 1 unless overridden
not_allowed: Do not use 33/33/34 module balancing; do not inflate C artificially.
logging_policy: Keep exact v35.1 detector-input features, extra online diagnostics for future detector improvement, analysis-only fault metadata/labels/deltas, target pool manifest, sampled target summary, and record-completeness audit.
note: v54 record-audit package: D_out targets d_model_norm and d_lm_head are included. Posthoc labels are evaluation-only and never detector features.
